title: Partie Septentrionale du Cercle de Haute Saxe qui contient le Duche de Pomeranie et le Marquisat de Brandebourg
author: Didier Robert de Vaugondy
publication_or_privilege_date: 1751 (royal privilege); first issued in the 1757 Atlas Universel
date_basis: The 1751 date is the PRIVILEGE date carried on the plate. The political state it depicts was not established, and the sheet was still being issued in 1757, so plate date, issue date and represented date are three different things and only the first is known.
holding_institution: Ksiaznica Pomorska, Szczecin (Zachodniopomorska Biblioteka Cyfrowa); also David Rumsey collection, list no. 3353.061
notes: LINEAGE WARNING: this is a Vaugondy Atlas Universel plate, the SAME house and atlas as the 1756 Haute Saxe sheet already in production. It is therefore a primary source for Brandenburg but NOT an independent corroboration of the existing Vaugondy geometry.

title: Carte de l'Empire d'Allemagne divise en ses dix cercles
author: Robert de Vaugondy
date_basis: catalogue date only; not checked against the raster
